snippet.title: IShowSpeed Says GTA 6 Put His Name in the Game With Lucia’s Watkins Auto Parts Job
snippet.description: the shop shows up as ‘Watkins Auto Parts’, and Speed’s real name is Darren Jason Watkins Jr. When he first spotted the sign in Trailer 2, he called his dad. His dad told him a real shop with the exact same name was opened by the streamer’s grandfather in the 1950s. Write it as Speed’s claim, though. Rockstar has not confirmed any official connection between IShowSpeed and GTA 6.
